model.name: SprintPinResolver.sprintSlugOf
model.description: sprintSlugOf(unit): the CANONICAL sprint slug = the real on-disk dir, resolved by a FALLBACK CHAIN (NEVER slugify(model.name)): (1) /sprints/(sprint-[^/]+)/ on sourceFile/compoundSource [S20: compoundSource points into the dir]; (2) else model.slug IF scrum.pmo/sprints/<slug>/ EXISTS [S37: compoundSource=consistency-guard-scope.md has no /sprints/, but model.slug=sprint-37-consistency-by-construction + dir exists]; (3) else the on-disk sprint-<model.number>-* dir. MUST resolve to an EXISTING dir - if none resolves, REFUSE (fail-closed, ties R-C3), never invent/slugify-name. slugify(model.name) is the S20 phantom (sprint-20-radical-forward-planning-... = no dir). INV-C1-8 extended: no name-derived NUMBER or SLUG; grep-lint BITE catches slugify(name). R-C1 DRY addendum +1.
